Message.Name: Reference Price Message
Message.Description: Reference prices are published for instruments with an InstrumentID for the Official, Settlement, Closing and Index price types. Instruments are published in the Instrument Definition message.

Field.Name: TimeOfEvent
Field.Description: The time at which the price was established.

Field.Name: ReferencePriceCategory
Field.Description: Category of the reference price. The specification names this field Category; it is qualified here because the Reference FX Rate message gives a Category of its own carrying a different set of values.

Field.Name: ReferencePriceType
Field.Description: Reference price type. The specification names this field PriceType; it is qualified here because the Contract Definition message gives a PriceType of its own carrying a different set of values.

Field.Name: PriceStatus
Field.Description: The status of reference price.

Field.Name: BusinessDate
Field.Description: The business date on which the price was established, as YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: InstrumentID
Field.Description: Unique Instrument Identifier. Null for PriceType Index.

Field.Name: ProductCode
Field.Description: The product code. This identifies the metal for the instrument.

Field.Name: CurrencyCode
Field.Description: The currency code according to ISO 4217.

Field.Name: Bid
Field.Description: A reference bid price, in implicit six decimal place format. Represents the average bid price for a reference price categorised as such.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: A reference price, in implicit six decimal place format. For an Average represents the mean of bid ask averages.

Field.Name: Ask
Field.Description: A reference ask price, in implicit six decimal place format. Represents the average ask price for a reference price categorised as such.

Message.Name: Reference Forward Curve Price Message
Message.Description: Indicative and closing prices for Carries and indicative prices for the Aluminium Premiums.

Field.Name: TimeOfEvent
Field.Description: The time at which the price was established.

Field.Name: BusinessDate
Field.Description: The business date on which the price was established, as YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: ProductCode
Field.Description: The product code. This identifies the metal for the instrument.

Field.Name: PriceStatus
Field.Description: The status of reference price.

Field.Name: CurrencyCode
Field.Description: The currency code according to ISO 4217.

Field.Name: RemainingRecords
Field.Description: Number of remaining prices to be published for a product. When the value of RemainingRecords equals RecordCount this is the last message for the product.

Field.Name: RecordCount
Field.Description: The number of reference prices in this message.

Field.Name: Curve Prices
Field.Description: The reference prices carried by this message, counted by RecordCount.

Message.Name: Reference FX Rate Message
Message.Description: Exchange FX rates are published for the Cash prompt. Daily and Monthly Moving Average Exchange FX rates are published each day, with the Monthly Average Exchange FX rate published on the last business day of the month. MonthlyMovingAverage and MonthlyAverage are published only for the Exchange category.

Field.Name: FxRateCategory
Field.Description: FX rate category. The specification names this field Category; it is qualified here because the Reference Price message gives a Category of its own carrying a different set of values.

Field.Name: FxRateType
Field.Description: FX rate type. The specification names this field Type; it is qualified here because the Open Interest and Warrant Band messages give a Type of their own carrying different sets of values.

Field.Name: BusinessDate
Field.Description: The business date on which the rate was confirmed, as YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: The business date to which the rate applies, as YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: BaseCurrencyCode
Field.Description: The currency code according to ISO 4217.

Field.Name: TargetCurrencyCode
Field.Description: The currency code according to ISO 4217.

Field.Name: ConversionRate
Field.Description: The conversion rate between base and target currencies, in implicit six decimal place format.

Message.Name: Reference Volatility Price Message
Message.Description: Provides raw strikes. LME volatilities are quoted in Delta space, and the strikes for which LME provide volatilities correspond to plus or minus 5, 10 and 25, the 50 delta, the at the money strike and the tradable strikes for the instrument. The calculated Call Premium and Put Premium are provided for each volatility and strike price for both Traded Options and TAPOs.

Field.Name: TimeOfEvent
Field.Description: Time at which the volatility surface was benchmarked.

Field.Name: BusinessDate
Field.Description: Business date for which the volatility surface was benchmarked, as YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: ContractCode
Field.Description: Contract code of the Option or TAPO.

Field.Name: ExpiryDate
Field.Description: Option expiry date, as YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: RemainingRecords
Field.Description: Number of volatilities to be published. When the value of RemainingRecords equals RecordCount this is the last message for the expiry date in the contract.

Field.Name: RecordCount
Field.Description: Number of reference volatility points which describes the reference volatility curve for the expiry date in this contract.

Field.Name: Volatility Points
Field.Description: The reference volatility points carried by this message, counted by RecordCount.
